title: 第0023章温泉低语气血异变第0024章暗巷惊魂百岁隐士初现身
content_zh:
;;
凰溪岛的暮春，总是裹着一层湿漉漉的海雾。
傍晚六点刚过，夕阳被厚重的云层揉碎，金红色的光洒在环岛公路上，将路边的棕榈树影子拉得老长。海风卷着咸腥气，混着度假区特有的温泉硫磺味，扑在人脸上，暖烘烘的，却又在不经意间，透出一丝刺骨的凉。
贾黑米扛着半人高的清洁工具，缩在凰溪岛温泉度假区后勤通道的拐角，大口喘着气。
额角的汗水顺着脸颊往下淌，滑进衣领，黏腻地贴在皮肤上。他抬手抹了一把，指腹蹭过粗糙的工装布料，留下一道灰黑的印子。此刻他的气血值，还停留在三点七——这是一个连凰溪岛最低等武道预备生都不如的数字，在全民高武的蓝星纪元，等同于彻头彻尾的废柴。
今天是他在温泉度假区打零工的第三十七天。
为了凑够下个月武道高考预选的报名费，也为了给自己那台快要报废的气血测试仪换一块新电池，贾黑米几乎包揽了后勤区所有最累、最脏的活。清扫温泉池底的淤积物、搬运更换温泉水的过滤芯、修剪度假区后山疯长的杂草，从清晨五点忙到深夜十点，一天下来，双腿像灌了铅一样沉重。
后勤主管是个满脸横肉的中年武者，气血值堪堪破十，在普通人里算个好手，却总爱拿贾黑米寻开心。
“贾黑米，我说你这身子骨，连只废土流浪狗都不如，还想参加武道高考？我看你是想屁吃！”
“赶紧把三号温泉池清理干净，今晚有武道馆的贵客过来，要是耽误了事，你这个月的工钱一分都别想要！”
刻薄的话语还在耳边回荡，贾黑米咬了咬下唇，把所有的委屈和不甘，全都咽进肚子里。
他从小在凰溪岛的贫民区长大，父母在他十岁那年，死于一场突如其来的“诡异发狂事件”——事后武道联盟贴出公告，说是废土异兽偷渡入境，可只有贾黑米记得，那天晚上，父母嘴里不停念叨着奇怪的话语，眼神空洞，像是被什么东西勾走了魂魄。
从那以后，他就成了孤儿，靠着贫民区的救济和打零工苟活。
灵气复苏百年，蓝星人人修炼，气血武道定强弱，序列异能分高低。武道高考，是底层少年唯一逆天改命的机会。贾黑米不是没有梦想，他也想气血破百，觉醒序列异能，成为镇守一方的武者，可天不遂人愿，他的气血天生孱弱，十六岁成年礼觉醒仪式上，更是连一丝一毫的序列波动都没有出现。
“废柴”、“异类”、“死人堆里爬出来的晦气东西”……
这些标签，像枷锁一样，从他少年时期一直捆到现在。
贾黑米深吸一口气，压下胸腔里翻涌的酸涩，扛起高压水枪，走向三号vip温泉池。
三号池是整个度假区最顶级的温泉区域，只对武道世家子弟和高阶武者开放。池边铺着雪白的大理石，四周种着珍稀的灵植，空气中弥漫着灵草的清香，与普通温泉区的硫磺味截然不同。
此刻天色渐暗，温泉池还没有客人到来，只有几盏暖黄色的景观灯，亮着柔和的光。
贾黑米放下工具，准备先清理池边的落叶。

就在他弯腰的瞬间，一股极其细微、像是蚊虫振翅的声音，突然钻进了他的耳朵里。
不是海风，不是灵植晃动，更不是温泉水流动的声音。
那声音很轻，很柔，像是有人在他耳边用气声低语，含糊不清，却又带着一种莫名的蛊惑力，往他的骨头缝里钻。
“……冷……好冷……”
“……放弃吧……你永远都是废物……”
“……死了就不痛了……来这里……”
贾黑米浑身一僵，猛地直起身。
四周空无一人。
温泉池水面平静，灵植无风自动，海雾缓缓飘来，将整个三号池笼罩在一片朦胧之中。没有任何人影，也没有任何异常的动静，可那低语声，却越来越清晰，像是贴着他的耳膜在说话。
他的心脏，骤然缩紧。
诡异！
是诡异事件的前兆！
凰溪岛地处都市与废土交界，近几年，“诡异发狂”事件频发。武道联盟给出的解释是，废土异兽携带诡异毒素，侵蚀人类心智。可贾黑米隐隐觉得，事情根本不是这么简单——那些发狂的人，眼神空洞，语气癫狂，嘴里念叨的全是听不懂的怪话，像是被某种看不见的东西，撬开了心灵的缝隙。
贾黑米下意识地摸向腰间——那里别着一把后勤区配发的最低等合金匕首，是他唯一的防身武器。
他的气血值只有三点七，别说对抗诡异，就算是一只最低阶的蚀骨鼠，都能轻松把他撕成碎片。
跑！
这是贾黑米脑海里第一个念头。
他转身就要往后勤通道冲，可双脚却像是被钉在了大理石地面上，动弹不得。
那诡异的低语声，此刻已经不再是含糊的气声，而是化作了密密麻麻的丝线，钻进他的脑海，缠绕着他的神经。
“你天生孱弱，父母双亡，活在世上就是累赘……”

In late spring on Huangxi Island, there is always a layer of wet sea fog.
Just after six o'clock in the evening, the setting sun was shattered by thick clouds, and the golden-red light shone on the ring road, making the shadows of the palm trees on the roadside grow long. The sea breeze carried a salty smell, mixed with the resort's unique hot spring sulfur smell, and hit people's faces. It was warm, but inadvertently, it revealed a biting coldness.
Carrying a cleaning tool half as tall as a man, Jia Heimi huddled in the corner of the logistics corridor of Huangxi Island Hot Spring Resort, gasping for air.
The sweat on his forehead trickled down his cheeks, slipped into his collar, and stuck to his skin stickyly. He raised his hand and wiped it, and his fingertips rubbed against the rough work clothes fabric, leaving a gray and black mark. At this moment, his health value is still at 3.7 - this is a number that is inferior to even the lowest martial arts preparatory students on Huangxi Island. In the Blue Star era where everyone is highly skilled in martial arts, he is equivalent to a complete loser.
Today is the thirty-seventh day of his odd job at the hot spring resort.
In order to collect the registration fee for the preliminaries for the martial arts college entrance examination next month, and to replace a new battery for his qi and blood tester that was about to be scrapped, Jia Heimi did almost all the most tiring and dirty work in the logistics area. Cleaning the silt at the bottom of the hot spring pool, transporting and replacing the filter elements of the hot spring water, and trimming the overgrown weeds in the mountains behind the resort. I was busy from five o'clock in the morning to ten o'clock in the evening. At the end of the day, my legs felt as heavy as lead.
The logistics manager is a middle-aged warrior with a sinister face and a vitality value of over 10. He is considered a good hand among ordinary people, but he always likes to take advantage of Jia Heimi for fun.
"Jia Heimi, I said your body is worse than a stray dog in the wasteland, and you still want to take the martial arts college entrance examination? I think you want to eat shit!"
"Hurry up and clean up the No. 3 hot spring pool. There are distinguished guests from the martial arts hall coming tonight. If you delay, you won't get a cent of your salary this month!"
With the harsh words still echoing in his ears, Jia Heimi bit his lower lip and swallowed all his grievances and unwillingness.
He grew up in the slums of Huangxi Island. When he was ten years old, his parents died in a sudden "weird and crazy incident". Afterwards, the Martial Arts Alliance posted a notice saying that alien beasts from the wasteland were smuggled into the country. But only Jia Heimi remembered that that night, his parents kept mumbling strange words, and their eyes were empty, as if something had taken away their souls.
Since then, he has been an orphan, surviving on ghetto relief and odd jobs.
Spiritual energy has been revived for hundreds of years, and everyone in Blue Star has practiced it. Qi, blood, and martial arts determine the strength and weakness, and the sequence of abilities is divided into high and low levels. The martial arts college entrance examination is the only opportunity for young people at the bottom to change their lives against the odds. It's not that Jia Heimi doesn't have dreams. He also wants to break through 100 qi and blood, awaken his sequence powers, and become a warrior guarding one side. However, things don't work out as he wishes. His qi and blood are naturally weak. During the awakening ceremony of his sixteenth-year-old coming-of-age ceremony, not even the slightest sequence fluctuation appeared.
"Good-for-nothing", "alien", "unlucky thing crawling out of the dead"...
These labels, like shackles, have been binding him since his youth until now.
Jia Heimi took a deep breath, suppressed the soreness in his chest, picked up the high-pressure water gun, and walked towards the VIP hot spring pool No. 3.
Pool No. 3 is the top hot spring area in the entire resort and is only open to disciples of martial arts families and high-level warriors. The edge of the pool is paved with snow-white marble, and rare spiritual plants are planted around it. The air is filled with the fragrance of spiritual plants, which is completely different from the sulfur smell in ordinary hot spring areas.
It was getting dark at this moment, and no guests had arrived in the hot spring pool yet. There were only a few warm yellow landscape lights shining softly.
Jia Heimi put down his tools and prepared to clean up the fallen leaves by the pool first.
The moment he bent down, an extremely subtle sound, like the flapping of mosquito wings, suddenly penetrated his ears.
It's not the sea breeze, it's not the swaying of spiritual plants, it's not the sound of hot spring water flowing.
The voice was very soft and soft, as if someone was whispering breathlessly in his ear, vaguely.Qing, but with an inexplicable bewitching power, it penetrated into the seams of his bones.
"...cold...so cold..."
"...Give up...you will always be a waste..."
"...it won't hurt if you die...come here..."
Jiahemi stiffened and straightened up suddenly.
There was no one around.
The water surface of the hot spring pool is calm, the spiritual plants are moving automatically without wind, and the sea fog slowly floats in, shrouding the entire No. 3 pool in hazy. There was no sign of anyone, and there was no unusual movement, but the whispers became increasingly clear, as if they were speaking against his eardrums.
His heart suddenly tightened.
Weird!
It's a precursor to strange events!
Huangxi Island is located at the junction of the city and the wasteland. In recent years, "weird and crazy" incidents have occurred frequently. The explanation given by the Martial Arts Alliance is that the alien beasts from the wasteland carry strange toxins and corrode the human mind. But Jia Heimi had a vague feeling that things were not that simple at all - those crazy people had empty eyes, crazy voices, and all they were saying were strange words that they couldn't understand, as if something invisible had pried open the gap in their souls.
Jiahemi subconsciously touched his waist - there was a low-grade alloy dagger issued by the logistics area, which was his only self-defense weapon.
His health value is only 3.7. Not to mention fighting against the weird, even the lowest level bone-eating rat can easily tear him into pieces.
run!
This was the first thought in Jahmi's mind.
He turned around and was about to rush towards the logistics aisle, but his feet seemed to be nailed to the marble floor, unable to move.
The strange whisper was no longer a muffled breath at this moment, but turned into dense threads, getting into his mind and entangling his nerves.
"You are born weak and your parents are dead. You are a burden in this world..."
